content.text: March Madness LIVE: The 2026 NCAA Tournament is underway and Chat Sports is here to provide live scoreboards and free play-by-play for Round of 64 games on Day 1 of the men’s tournament. The March Madness highlights have already been out in full force with upset wins for 12-seed High Point and 11 seeds Texas and VCU. Today’s March Madness games will air on CBS, TNT, TBS and truTV, but if you don’t have cable or access to those channels, join Chat Sports’ host Tyler Smith and the rest of the gang for FREE coverage and analysis of today’s NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament games.
